audience: limousine and chauffeur companies that run bookings in LimoExpress

useCases.title: Review the pickups of tomorrow
useCases.text: List the bookings for a pickup time range and filter by status. See which ones are not confirmed yet.

useCases.title: Find the unpaid invoices
useCases.text: List the invoices with their paid status. Read the client list to see who must pay.

useCases.title: Quote a trip price
useCases.text: Get the price for a trip from coordinates for one vehicle class. Add the extra fees for the same class and currency.

useCases.title: Check the fleet and the team
useCases.text: List the vehicles, the vehicle classes and the staff and drivers of the organisation.

useCases.title: Confirm a booking
useCases.text: Find a booking in the list and set it to the confirmed status.

useCases.title: Record that a client paid an invoice
useCases.text: Find the invoice in the list and mark it as paid. This changes the accounting state.
